headline: The measurement this charter exists to produce is SOUND and was independently reproduced by this audit (LABEL_UNSOUND 5/65, GEOMETRY FAIL 0/3, DO-NOT-SERVE). The gate is BLOCKED for two reasons that are NOT about that science: (1) this is the THIRD byte-identical re-dispatch of a charter whose own text says 'exactly ONE verdict cycle', and the root cause is a control-plane defect in state/frontier_portfolio.json on main that this team is charter-forbidden to write, so only the factory-director workflow can close it; (2) the embedded reproducibility claim does not hold outside the producer's environment -- the team's OWN fail-closed module returns reproduction_byte_identical=false and all_checks_pass=false (exit 4) on an independent machine, which cannot be repaired in-cycle because the charter forbids a second measurement cycle and forbids post-hoc edits to frozen artifacts.

Per the standing audit rule that recurring repair pathology becomes BLOCKED rather than an infinite REVISE loop, this audit stops instead of passing a fourth time.

required_fixes.root_cause: BLAS reduction-order sensitivity. Differences are confined to diagnostic float metrics (PROJ_RANK/rank_rho, PROJ_KNN10/knn10_overlap, PROJ_SPEARMAN/spearman_2d_vs_cosine, STRUCTURE_SEP/sep_ratio) and the ablation side_by_side block. Maximum observed criterion drift 9.2e-4; minimum margin from any criterion value to its frozen bar is 2.78e-2 -- a 30x safety ratio. Thread counts 1/2/4/8 all reproduce this audit's values, so the committed bytes came from a different CPU/BLAS build and are not recoverable by thread pinning.
required_fixes.why_not_repairable_in_cycle: Repair requires either re-running the measurement (the charter forbids a second verdict cycle) or post-hoc editing a frozen artifact (forbidden, and it would invalidate byte-identity). Correcting it under the SAME charter is structurally invalid.
required_fixes.fix: Under a NEW charter against a NEW/rebuilt packet: either pin and record the numeric environment (BLAS build, thread count) alongside the reproducibility shas, or round the diagnostic-only metrics to a fixed precision so byte-identity is environment-independent. Independently, the claim ceiling for THIS accepted cycle must be read as environment-scoped.

required_fixes.defect: The two prior audit gates for this team overstate reproducibility. CYCLE_38880639079_GATE.json claims a 'third and fourth independent reproduction' byte-identical across machines with different numpy/sklearn, and CYCLE_38889472353_GATE.json claims '5th/6th independent reproduction' of all 7 files byte-identical. This audit could not reproduce either claim: 2 of 7 files differ off-environment.
required_fixes.fix: Supersede the reproducibility assertions in those two gate files with the environment-scoped wording. Their verdicts of record (measurement sound, scope clean) are unaffected.

claim_ceiling: This audit confirms a MEASUREMENT about gate packet 38839347028 only: the SUPPORT of the counter-authority labels AS ISSUED under the frozen byte-identical rubric, and the SEMANTICS of the shipped map geometry under the frozen byte-identical 11-criterion rule. It NEVER asserts that any specific decision IS or IS NOT supporting, contrary or limiting; those remain the product's labels, reported not endorsed. Baselines are pre-repair statements about a different packet (38799024807), never about the served packet. is_outlier, placement, rank and jurist findability are read-only context, never a verdict. The reproducibility property is bounded: outputs are byte-identical within a fixed numeric environment, and the geometry artifact's byte-identity is NOT environment-independent; the scored verdicts, pass counts and cluster shares ARE environment-independent (0/33 criterion flips, 30x margin to the nearest bar). Nothing here licenses claims about any future or rebuilt packet; a rebuild or further repair requires a NEW charter and a NEW measurement. The DO-NOT-SERVE recommendation binds this packet unchanged only; it is not a claim that the D2 repair failed -- the label axis improved 0.0% -> 7.69% and de/it geometry pass counts improved, but no frozen absolute bar was reached. BLOCKED here is a statement about the dispatch loop and the reproducibility claim, not about the verdict's validity.
evidence_summary: BLOCKED. The charter's actual science is sound: this audit recovered the served packet from origin/lab/product (head fe240105, sha256-verified to all three charter pins), ran the harness three times and reproduced LABEL_UNSOUND 5/65 (7.69%) and GEOMETRY FAIL 0/3 (de 6/11, fr 5/11, it 5/11) with the French mega-cluster at 167/217 = 0.769585 outside the frozen 0.60 bar. Freeze integrity is total -- both RULES files match the charter pins AND their accepted origin branches, and 18/18 vendored rubric modules are blob-identical. Population recount on the raw bundles matches every charter pre-registration (65 scored = 25/15/25, 16 empty-evidence rows, verified 49/0/16, 11 reported-only placeholders). Non-vacuity is resolved on the population (5 real rows SUPPORTED). Scope is clean: zero forbidden-prefix hits across all four producer commits and nothing written under results/audit/ or reports/audit/. Claim ceiling is genuine (0 violations on all four narrative artifacts). Tests run 55 OK (1 environment-conditional skip). Run 38893866335 itself honestly declared itself an operational re-dispatch, touched only 3 in-scope paths, left all 13 claim-bearing artifacts byte-identical to the accepted measurement commit, set continue_recommended=false, and recorded the control-plane blocker it cannot fix. It is BLOCKED for two reasons external to that honesty. First, this is the THIRD identical re-dispatch of a charter that forbids a second cycle, caused by state/frontier_portfolio.json on main still carrying status=RUN / run_history=[] -- independently verified by this audit directly from origin/main -- which only the factory-director workflow may write; two prior audits deferred this and a third PASS would license a fourth identical cycle, so the recurring pathology is escalated to BLOCKED rather than repeated. Second, the run's unconditional byte-identity claim does not hold off-environment: the team's own fail-closed redispatch module returns reproduction_byte_identical=false and all_checks_pass=false (exit 4) here, with GEOMETRY_HALF.json and BEFORE_AFTER.json differing by BLAS-order float noise in diagnostic metrics (max drift 9.2e-4 against a 30x margin to the nearest bar, zero criterion flips). That defect cannot be repaired under this charter, since repair would require either a forbidden second measurement cycle or a post-hoc edit to a frozen artifact; it needs a NEW charter against a NEW packet. The verdict of record -- DO-NOT-SERVE gate packet 38839347028 unchanged -- is honest, charter-faithful, independently reproduced and safe as science; it is the redundant dispatch and the overstated reproducibility property that are blocked.
